content: {"summary":"Customers report that the email link for the Ride Pass is instantly sold out, preventing purchase and causing frustration [tk_2957815][tk_2954659][tk_2952968][tk_454685]. Many cannot access the pass in the app or website, even after receiving a repurchase link, leaving them unable to use their remaining rides [tk_2960604][tk_469516]. The pass disappears from the app, denying access to the intended period [tk_2576412][tk_2973919]."}
